name: Lympo
rootCause: Sports NFT platform Lympo suffered a hot wallet security breach, losing 165.2 million LMT tokens worth $18.7 million in the hack. Ten different project wallets were compromised in the attack. Quotes show that the LMT price plummeted 92% to $0.0093 after hackers moved and sold the loot in the project’s hot wallet.

descriptions.text: Sports NFT platform Lympo suffered a hot wallet security breach, losing 165.2 million LMT tokens worth $18.7 million in the hack. Ten different project wallets were compromised in the attack. Quotes show that the LMT price plummeted 92% to $0.0093 after hackers moved and sold the loot in the project’s hot wallet.

Lympo, a sports NFT platform under Animoca Brands, suffered a hot wallet key compromise on January 10, 2022, resulting in the theft of approximately 165.2 million LMT tokens (worth about $18.7 million at the time). Stolen tokens were sold on DeFi exchanges and liquidity was removed to mitigate price impact. An attacker gained unauthorized access to Lympo's operational hot wallet keys, allowing the transfer of 165.2 million LMT tokens. This was an off-chain key compromise rather than a contract bug.

Animoca Brands' subsidiary Lympo, an NFT platform specifically for sports, experienced a breach of several hot wallets . This allowed an attacker to pull 165.2 LMT tokens from the platform, equivalent to about $18.7 million. The tokens were quickly exchanged for Ether on Uniswap and Sushiswap. The hack caused the value of LMT to drop by 92%, to $0.0093.
